fusions.name: Long-Held Incantation
fusions.desc: After 2 seconds held motionless, looses a bolt that deals 30 damage and bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Correcting Word
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Speaks a word at it from up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, with a 50% chance of [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearse Again
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and your dodge chance rises 10%.

fusions.name: Waited-For Word
fusions.desc: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
